# Exposed battery source stock

This fixture copies all 29 unchanged `SOURCE_MEMBERS`, the original 576,273-byte
manufacturer PDF, the frozen selection protocol and the original source intake
register from the retained `battery-broad02/battery-source-originals` custody.
The census retains their original source identity, byte sizes and SHA256 digests.
The PyBaMM license is copied unchanged from the cached 26.6.2.0 distribution;
all 29 cached source files were also checked against the retained copies.

The compressed archive is deterministic and contains no links. Tests authenticate
its complete member census before copying it into a fresh temporary directory.
An exposed distribution metadata locator points to those copies. No PyBaMM
import, solver entry, external access or new acquisition is required.

This is exposed development stock for portable metadata conformance. It supplies
no fresh qualification, physical units, manufacturer approval or execution
authority. Historical records and the source/protocol contracts are unchanged.
